1	/**
2	 * Payments reconciliation cron — runs hourly at :05.
3	 *
4	 * Phase A — Dodo subscriptions: lists all active Dodo subscriptions via API,
5	 *   compares against the `subscriptions` table, logs any drift.
6	 *
7	 * Phase B — Stripe charges: loads Charges created in the last 25 hours
8	 *   from the Stripe API, compares against the `stripe_charges` table, logs drift.
9	 *
10	 * Phase C — writes a structured reconciliation report to the pino logger.
11	 *   No writes to the DB in S14 — `reconciliation_reports` table deferred to S15+.
12	 *
13	 * Resilience: Phase A and Phase B are independent. If one throws, the other
14	 * still completes. Both results are captured before final log.
15	 *
16	 * Idempotent: read-only in S14, no mutation risk on restart.
17	 */
18	
19	import cron from 'node-cron'
20	import type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'
21	import type { SubscriptionListResponse } from 'dodopayments/resources/subscriptions.js'
22	import type { Charge } from 'stripe/cjs/resources/Charges.js'
23	import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase'
24	import { logger } from '../lib/logger'
25	import { getStripe } from './shared/stripe'
26	import { getDodo } from './shared/dodo'
27	import { RPC } from '@/lib/payments/contracts'
28	import type { CommissionSplitsDriftCheckResult } from '@/lib/payments/contracts'
29	
30	// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
31	
32	interface DodoDrift {
33	  in_api_not_in_db: string[]
34	  in_db_not_in_api: string[]
35	  status_mismatch: Array<{ id: string; api: string; db: string }>
36	}
37	
38	interface StripeDrift {
39	  in_api_not_in_db: string[]
40	  status_mismatch: Array<{ charge_id: string; api: string; db: string }>
41	  amount_mismatch: Array<{ charge_id: string; api_cents: string; db_cents: string }>
42	}
43	
44	type DodoPhaseResult = DodoDrift | { error: string }
45	type StripePhaseResult = StripeDrift | { error: string }
46	
47	interface PiMissingSplit {
48	  payment_intent_id: string
49	  charge_id: string | null
50	  studio_id: string
51	  created_at: string
52	}
53	
54	interface DisputeMissingReversal {
55	  dispute_id: string
56	  charge_id: string
57	  studio_id: string
58	  resolved_at: string | null
59	}
60	
61	interface ChargeMissingTaxLine {
62	  payment_intent_id: string
63	  charge_id: string | null
64	  studio_id: string
65	  tax_amount_cents: number
66	}
67	
68	interface RefundMissingTaxReversal {
69	  refund_id: string
70	  payment_intent_id: string
71	  studio_id: string
72	  missing_jurisdictions: string[]
73	}
74	
75	interface CommissionSplitsDrift {
76	  pis_missing_split: PiMissingSplit[]
77	  disputes_missing_reversal: DisputeMissingReversal[]
78	  // Leg 3 (S17): charges with tax but no tax_line attribution
79	  charges_missing_tax_line?: ChargeMissingTaxLine[]
80	  // Leg 4 (S18): refunds that reversed parent split but missed tax_line reversal
81	  refunds_missing_tax_reversal?: RefundMissingTaxReversal[]
82	}
83	
84	type CommissionPhaseResult = CommissionSplitsDrift | { error: string }
85	
86	interface ReconciliationReport {
87	  dodo: DodoPhaseResult
88	  stripe: StripePhaseResult
89	  commission_splits: CommissionPhaseResult
90	  duration_ms: number
91	  ran_at: string
92	}
93	
94	/**
95	 * DB row shape for stripe_charges.
96	 * Typed inline because lib/supabase/types.ts has not been regenerated
97	 * after the 20260505100000 migration yet — regenerate with `pnpm db:types`.
98	 */
99	interface StripeChargeDbRow {
100	  id: string
101	  charge_id: string | null
102	  payment_intent_id: string
103	  status: string
104	  amount_cents: string | number   // Supabase returns bigint columns as string
105	}
106	
107	// ─── Dodo reconciliation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
108	
109	async function reconcileDodo(client: SupabaseClient): Promise<DodoDrift> {
110	  const dodo = getDodo()
111	
112	  // Collect all active subscriptions from Dodo using the SDK's async iterator
113	  // (DefaultPageNumberPagination implements AsyncIterable<Item>)
114	  const apiSubs = new Map<string, SubscriptionListResponse>()
115	  for await (const sub of dodo.subscriptions.list({ status: 'active', page_size: 100 })) {
116	    apiSubs.set(sub.subscription_id, sub)
117	  }
118	
119	  // Load our DB state — active subscriptions with a Dodo subscription ID recorded
120	  const { data: dbRows, error: dbErr } = await client
121	    .from('subscriptions')
122	    .select('id, dodo_subscription_id, status')
123	    .eq('status', 'active')
124	    .not('dodo_subscription_id', 'is', null)
125	
126	  if (dbErr) {
127	    throw new Error(`reconcileDodo: DB query failed — ${dbErr.message}`)
128	  }
129	
130	  const dbMap = new Map<string, { id: string; status: string }>(
131	    (dbRows ?? []).map((row) => [
132	      row.dodo_subscription_id as string,
133	      { id: row.id, status: row.status as string },
134	    ]),
135	  )
136	
137	  const drift: DodoDrift = {
138	    in_api_not_in_db: [],
139	    in_db_not_in_api: [],
140	    status_mismatch: [],
141	  }
142	
143	  for (const [subId, apiSub] of apiSubs) {
144	    const dbRow = dbMap.get(subId)
145	    if (!dbRow) {
146	      drift.in_api_not_in_db.push(subId)
147	    } else if (dbRow.status !== apiSub.status) {
148	      drift.status_mismatch.push({ id: subId, api: apiSub.status, db: dbRow.status })
149	    }
150	  }
151	
152	  for (const dbSubId of dbMap.keys()) {
153	    if (!apiSubs.has(dbSubId)) {
154	      drift.in_db_not_in_api.push(dbSubId)
155	    }
156	  }
157	
158	  return drift
159	}
160	
161	// ─── Stripe reconciliation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
162	
163	async function reconcileStripe(client: SupabaseClient): Promise<StripeDrift> {
164	  const stripe = getStripe()
165	
166	  // 25-hour window gives a safe overlap with the previous hourly run
167	  const sinceUnix = Math.floor((Date.now() - 25 * 60 * 60 * 1000) / 1000)
168	  const sinceIso = new Date(sinceUnix * 1000).toISOString()
169	
170	  // Collect all charges in the window using Stripe's async iterator
171	  const apiCharges = new Map<string, Charge>()
172	  for await (const charge of stripe.charges.list({ created: { gte: sinceUnix }, limit: 100 })) {
173	    apiCharges.set(charge.id, charge)
174	  }
175	
176	  // Load our DB state for the same window — only rows with a charge_id
177	  const { data: dbRows, error: dbErr } = await client
178	    .from('stripe_charges')
179	    .select('id, charge_id, payment_intent_id, status, amount_cents')
180	    .gte('created_at', sinceIso)
181	    .not('charge_id', 'is', null)
182	
183	  if (dbErr) {
184	    throw new Error(`reconcileStripe: DB query failed — ${dbErr.message}`)
185	  }
186	
187	  const dbMap = new Map<string, StripeChargeDbRow>(
188	    ((dbRows ?? []) as StripeChargeDbRow[]).map((row) => [row.charge_id as string, row]),
189	  )
190	
191	  const drift: StripeDrift = {
192	    in_api_not_in_db: [],
193	    status_mismatch: [],
194	    amount_mismatch: [],
195	  }
196	
197	  for (const [chargeId, apiCharge] of apiCharges) {
198	    const dbRow = dbMap.get(chargeId)
199	    if (!dbRow) {
200	      drift.in_api_not_in_db.push(chargeId)
201	      continue
202	    }
203	
204	    // Status comparison
205	    if (dbRow.status !== apiCharge.status) {
206	      drift.status_mismatch.push({
207	        charge_id: chargeId,
208	        api: apiCharge.status,
209	        db: dbRow.status,
210	      })
211	    }
212	
213	    // Amount comparison — all money is bigint (cents). Serialise as string for safe JSON logging.
214	    const dbCents = BigInt(dbRow.amount_cents)
215	    const apiCents = BigInt(apiCharge.amount)
216	    if (dbCents !== apiCents) {
217	      drift.amount_mismatch.push({
218	        charge_id: chargeId,
219	        api_cents: apiCents.toString(),
220	        db_cents: dbCents.toString(),
221	      })
222	    }
223	  }
224	
225	  return drift
226	}
227	
228	// ─── Commission splits reconciliation ────────────────────────────────────────
229	
230	export async function reconcileCommissionSplits(
231	  client: SupabaseClient,
232	): Promise<CommissionSplitsDrift> {
233	  const since = new Date(Date.now() - 25 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString()
234	  const { data, error } = await client.rpc(RPC.COMMISSION_SPLITS_DRIFT_CHECK, {
235	    p_since_timestamp: since,
236	  })
237	  if (error) {
238	    throw new Error(`reconcileCommissionSplits: drift_check RPC failed — ${error.message}`)
239	  }
240	  return data as CommissionSplitsDriftCheckResult
241	}
242	
243	// ─── Report writer ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
244	
245	function isDodoDrift(r: DodoPhaseResult): r is DodoDrift {
246	  return !('error' in r)
247	}
248	
249	function isStripeDrift(r: StripePhaseResult): r is StripeDrift {
250	  return !('error' in r)
251	}
252	
253	function hasDodoDriftItems(d: DodoDrift): boolean {
254	  return d.in_api_not_in_db.length > 0 || d.in_db_not_in_api.length > 0 || d.status_mismatch.length > 0
255	}
256	
257	function hasStripeDriftItems(d: StripeDrift): boolean {
258	  return d.in_api_not_in_db.length > 0 || d.status_mismatch.length > 0 || d.amount_mismatch.length > 0
259	}
260	
261	function writeReconciliationReport(report: ReconciliationReport): void {
262	  const runLog = logger.child({ cron: 'payments-reconciliation' })
263	
264	  const dodoDriftDetected = isDodoDrift(report.dodo) && hasDodoDriftItems(report.dodo)
265	  const dodoErrored = !isDodoDrift(report.dodo)
266	  const stripeDriftDetected = isStripeDrift(report.stripe) && hasStripeDriftItems(report.stripe)
267	  const stripeErrored = !isStripeDrift(report.stripe)
268	
269	  if (dodoDriftDetected || dodoErrored || stripeDriftDetected || stripeErrored) {
270	    runLog.warn(report, 'payments-reconciliation: drift or errors detected')
271	  } else {
272	    runLog.info(report, 'payments-reconciliation: clean — no drift detected')
273	  }
274	
275	  // S14: logging only. Persist to reconciliation_reports table in S15+.
276	}
277	
278	// ─── Main handler ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
279	
280	export async function runPaymentsReconciliation(): Promise<void> {
281	  const startedAt = Date.now()
282	  logger.info({ cron: 'payments-reconciliation' }, 'payments-reconciliation: starting run')
283	
284	  // Phase A, B, and C are independent — one failure does not abort the others
285	  const [dodoResult, stripeResult, commissionResult] = await Promise.all([
286	    reconcileDodo(supabase).catch((err: unknown): { error: string } => {
287	      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)
288	      logger.error({ err, cron: 'payments-reconciliation' }, 'phase A (Dodo) failed')
289	      return { error: message }
290	    }),
291	    reconcileStripe(supabase).catch((err: unknown): { error: string } => {
292	      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)
293	      logger.error({ err, cron: 'payments-reconciliation' }, 'phase B (Stripe) failed')
294	      return { error: message }
295	    }),
296	    reconcileCommissionSplits(supabase).catch((err: unknown): { error: string } => {
297	      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)
298	      logger.error({ err, cron: 'payments-reconciliation' }, 'phase C (commission splits) failed')
299	      return { error: message }
300	    }),
301	  ])
302	
303	  if (!('error' in commissionResult)) {
304	    // Defensive: Leg 3 (S17) + Leg 4 (S18) may not be present in older drift_check responses.
305	    const charges_missing_tax_line = commissionResult.charges_missing_tax_line ?? [];
306	    const refunds_missing_tax_reversal = commissionResult.refunds_missing_tax_reversal ?? [];
307	
308	    const driftFound =
309	      commissionResult.pis_missing_split.length > 0 ||
310	      commissionResult.disputes_missing_reversal.length > 0 ||
311	      charges_missing_tax_line.length > 0 ||
312	      refunds_missing_tax_reversal.length > 0;
313	
314	    if (driftFound) {
315	      logger.warn({
316	        pis_missing_split: commissionResult.pis_missing_split.length,
317	        disputes_missing_reversal: commissionResult.disputes_missing_reversal.length,
318	        charges_missing_tax_line: charges_missing_tax_line.length,
319	        refunds_missing_tax_reversal: refunds_missing_tax_reversal.length,
320	        sample_pi_ids: commissionResult.pis_missing_split.slice(0, 5).map(p => p.payment_intent_id),
321	        sample_dispute_ids: commissionResult.disputes_missing_reversal.slice(0, 5).map(d => d.dispute_id),
322	        sample_tax_line_pi_ids: charges_missing_tax_line.slice(0, 5).map(c => c.payment_intent_id),
323	        sample_tax_reversal_pi_ids: refunds_missing_tax_reversal.slice(0, 5).map(r => r.payment_intent_id),
324	      }, 'phase C: commission_splits drift detected (4 legs)')
325	    }
326	  }
327	
328	  const report: ReconciliationReport = {
329	    dodo: dodoResult,
330	    stripe: stripeResult,
331	    commission_splits: commissionResult,
332	    duration_ms: Date.now() - startedAt,
333	    ran_at: new Date().toISOString(),
334	  }
335	
336	  writeReconciliationReport(report)
337	
338	  const commissionOk = !('error' in commissionResult)
339	  logger.info({
340	    cron: 'payments-reconciliation',
341	    dodo_in_api_not_in_db: isDodoDrift(dodoResult) ? dodoResult.in_api_not_in_db.length : 0,
342	    dodo_in_db_not_in_api: isDodoDrift(dodoResult) ? dodoResult.in_db_not_in_api.length : 0,
343	    dodo_status_mismatch: isDodoDrift(dodoResult) ? dodoResult.status_mismatch.length : 0,
344	    stripe_in_api_not_in_db: isStripeDrift(stripeResult) ? stripeResult.in_api_not_in_db.length : 0,
345	    stripe_status_mismatch: isStripeDrift(stripeResult) ? stripeResult.status_mismatch.length : 0,
346	    stripe_amount_mismatch: isStripeDrift(stripeResult) ? stripeResult.amount_mismatch.length : 0,
347	    commission_splits_pis_missing: commissionOk ? commissionResult.pis_missing_split.length : 0,
348	    commission_splits_disputes_missing: commissionOk ? commissionResult.disputes_missing_reversal.length : 0,
349	    commission_splits_charges_missing_tax_line: commissionOk ? (commissionResult.charges_missing_tax_line?.length ?? 0) : 0,
350	    commission_splits_refunds_missing_tax_reversal: commissionOk ? (commissionResult.refunds_missing_tax_reversal?.length ?? 0) : 0,
351	    duration_ms: Date.now() - startedAt,
352	  }, 'payments-reconciliation cron complete')
353	}
354	
355	// ─── Cron schedule ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
356	
357	// Every hour at :05 — slight offset avoids contention with :00 jobs
358	cron.schedule('5 * * * *', () => {
359	  runPaymentsReconciliation().catch((err: unknown) => {
360	    logger.error({ err }, 'cron: payments-reconciliation threw unexpectedly')
361	  })
362	})

1	/**
2	 * createSessionPaymentIntent — S16 core helper.
3	 *
4	 * Destination-charge flow for in-studio session settlement:
5	 *   1. Capability gate (L2 runtime block — CC from S15)
6	 *   2. Country alignment sanity check (CC18 — country immutable after account creation)
7	 *   3. Deposit pool SAGA step 1 — apply_deposit_to_session RPC (pending_apply row)
8	 *   4. Stripe PaymentIntent create with destination charge + application_fee_amount
9	 *   5. Mirror in stripe_charges table via stripe_charge_record RPC
10	 *
11	 * On PaymentIntent create failure: immediately roll back the deposit SAGA step 1
12	 * (rollback_deposit_application). Do NOT leave orphan pending_apply rows.
13	 *
14	 * INVARIANT 2: every Stripe call goes through withIdempotencyKey() + carries
15	 *              metadata.inkos_idempotency_key (enforced by the wrapper + explicit set).
16	 * INVARIANT 4: application_fee_amount is ALWAYS set (never undefined → studio gets nothing).
17	 * INVARIANT 7: This module is Stripe-only. No Dodo imports.
18	 * INVARIANT 8: Banker's rounding on commission splits (no systematic bias on .5 cents).
19	 *
20	 * Server-side only. Never import from client components.
21	 */
22	
23	import type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'
24	import type Stripe from 'stripe'
25	import { getStripe } from './client'
26	import { idempotencyKeyFor, withIdempotencyKey } from './idempotency'
27	import {
28	  requireStudioL2Enabled,
29	  CapabilityGateError,
30	} from '@/lib/payments/capability-gate'
31	import {
32	  RPC,
33	  type CentsAmount,
34	  type Currency,
35	  type ApplyDepositToSessionResult,
36	  type InkosIdempotencyKey,
37	} from '@/lib/payments/contracts'
38	import { logger } from '@/lib/logger'
39	
40	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
41	// Public types
42	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
43	
44	export interface CreateSessionPaymentIntentArgs {
45	  studioId: string
46	  bookingId: string
47	  projectId: string
48	  sessionId: string
49	  artistId: string
50	  clientId: string
51	  /** Stripe cus_xxx — must already exist; created during booking flow. */
52	  customerId: string
53	  /** Stripe pm_xxx — saved card on file. */
54	  paymentMethodId: string
55	  currency: Currency
56	  /** Session fee before deposit drawdown. */
57	  baseAmountCents: CentsAmount
58	  tipAmountCents: CentsAmount
59	  /** 0 if no drawdown from deposit pool. */
60	  depositDrawdownCents: CentsAmount
61	  /**
62	   * Artist's share of baseAmountCents expressed as a percentage (e.g. 70).
63	   * Studio receives (100 - commissionPct)% as the application_fee_amount.
64	   */
65	  commissionPct: number
66	  /**
67	   * Stripe acct_xxx for the artist's own Connect account.
68	   * null when the artist has not opted into direct payouts.
69	   * When null, the studio's connected account is the destination and payroll
70	   * handles artist disbursement out-of-band.
71	   */
72	  artistConnectedAccountId: string | null
73	  /** Stripe acct_xxx for the studio — always present. */
74	  studioConnectedAccountId: string
75	  /**
76	   * S18 — tip routing mode.
77	   * When true, tips flow to the studio's connected account (pooled for later distribution).
78	   * When false (default), tips flow to the artist's destination account via the destination charge.
79	   * Track C adds studios.tip_pool_enabled; this flag is resolved and passed from the charge route.
80	   */
81	  tipPoolEnabled: boolean
82	}
83	
84	export interface CreateSessionPaymentIntentResult {
85	  paymentIntentId: string
86	  clientSecret: string | null
87	  status: Stripe.PaymentIntent.Status
88	  /** null when depositDrawdownCents === 0. */
89	  depositTransactionId: string | null
90	  /** base + tip - drawdown — what the client is actually charged. */
91	  amountChargedCents: CentsAmount
92	}
93	
94	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
95	// Internal: commission split with banker's rounding (INVARIANT 8)
96	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
97	
98	interface CommissionSplit {
99	  applicationFeeCents: CentsAmount // studio's share (goes to platform as application_fee)
100	  netArtistCents: CentsAmount      // artist's share
101	}
102	
103	/**
104	 * Split baseAmountCents on commissionPct with banker's rounding (round half to even).
105	 *
106	 * Artist gets commissionPct%, studio gets (100 - commissionPct)%.
107	 * application_fee_amount = studio's cents (passed to Stripe as fee; stays on platform).
108	 * net_artist_cents = amount transferred to the destination (artist or studio account).
109	 */
110	function computeCommissionSplit(
111	  baseAmountCents: CentsAmount,
112	  commissionPct: number,
113	): CommissionSplit {
114	  // Studio share in raw fractional cents
115	  const studioPct = 100 - commissionPct
116	  const studioRaw = (baseAmountCents * studioPct) / 100
117	
118	  // Banker's rounding: round half to even to avoid systematic bias.
119	  const floored = Math.floor(studioRaw)
120	  const fraction = studioRaw - floored
121	  let applicationFeeCents: number
122	  if (fraction < 0.5) {
123	    applicationFeeCents = floored
124	  } else if (fraction > 0.5) {
125	    applicationFeeCents = floored + 1
126	  } else {
127	    // Exactly 0.5 — round to nearest even
128	    applicationFeeCents = floored % 2 === 0 ? floored : floored + 1
129	  }
130	
131	  const netArtistCents = baseAmountCents - applicationFeeCents
132	
133	  return {
134	    applicationFeeCents: applicationFeeCents as CentsAmount,
135	    netArtistCents: netArtistCents as CentsAmount,
136	  }
137	}
138	
139	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
140	// Internal: country alignment (CC18 — country immutable after account creation)
141	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
142	
143	/**
144	 * Verify studios.country matches the studio's stripe_connected_accounts.country.
145	 *
146	 * A mismatch means the studio's country field drifted after account creation.
147	 * Since Stripe's country is immutable on the account, any drift is a data integrity
148	 * issue that must be resolved via support before charges can proceed.
149	 *
150	 * Throws CapabilityGateError (422) on drift or missing country.
151	 */
152	async function ensureCountryAligned(
153	  supabase: SupabaseClient,
154	  studioId: string,
155	): Promise<void> {
156	  // §S13.3 — types.ts regen pending; cast for studios.country read.
157	  const [studioResult, accountResult] = await Promise.all([
158	    supabase
159	      .from('studios')
160	      .select('country')
161	      .eq('id', studioId)
162	      .single(),
163	    supabase
164	      .from('stripe_connected_accounts')
165	      .select('country')
166	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
167	      .eq('type', 'studio')
168	      .single(),
169	  ])
170	
171	  if (studioResult.error) throw studioResult.error
172	  if (accountResult.error) throw accountResult.error
173	
174	  const studioCountry = (studioResult.data as { country: string | null }).country
175	  const accountCountry = (accountResult.data as { country: string | null }).country
176	
177	  if (!studioCountry) {
178	    throw new CapabilityGateError(
179	      'country_missing',
180	      'Studio country must be set before charging.',
181	      422,
182	    )
183	  }
184	
185	  if (studioCountry !== accountCountry) {
186	    throw new CapabilityGateError(
187	      'country_drift',
188	      'Studio country no longer matches the Stripe account country. Contact support.',
189	      422,
190	    )
191	  }
192	}
193	
194	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
195	// createSessionPaymentIntent
196	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
197	
198	export async function createSessionPaymentIntent(
199	  supabase: SupabaseClient,
200	  args: CreateSessionPaymentIntentArgs,
201	): Promise<CreateSessionPaymentIntentResult> {
202	  const startedAt = Date.now()
203	
204	  // 1. Capability gate — FIRST DB call, throws CapabilityGateError if disabled.
205	  await requireStudioL2Enabled(supabase, args.studioId)
206	
207	  // 2. Country alignment sanity check (CC18 reinforced).
208	  await ensureCountryAligned(supabase, args.studioId)
209

216	    })

218	    const { data: applyData, error: applyErr } = await supabase.rpc(

223	        p_draw_cents: args.depositDrawdownCents,

241	  const amountChargedCents = (
242	    args.baseAmountCents + args.tipAmountCents - args.depositDrawdownCents
243	  ) as CentsAmount

279	
280	  const destinationAccount = args.artistConnectedAccountId ?? args.studioConnectedAccountId
281	
282	  // INVARIANT 4: application_fee_amount is ALWAYS set (never undefined).
283	  const effectiveApplicationFee: CentsAmount = (() => {
284	    if (args.artistConnectedAccountId === null) {
285	      // No artist Connect account — studio receives everything (base + tip via destination=studio).
286	      // Payroll distributes artist share out-of-band.
287	      return (args.baseAmountCents + args.tipAmountCents) as CentsAmount
288	    }
289	    if (tipDestination === 'studio') {

302	    session_id: args.sessionId,
303	  })
